title: Platform Engineering Engineer 3
jobDescription: Job Title Platform Engineering Engineer 3 About Your Business Area / Department The systems that support global travel operate at significant scale and require thoughtful approaches to scalability, resiliency, and geographic distribution. These platforms support more than 150 airlines, hundreds of websites, airports, and hotel properties worldwide, processing large volumes of transactions with consistently low response times. Summary of the Role The Platform Engineering Engineer 2 supports the design, management, and optimization of cloud and infrastructure platforms to ensure performance, reliability, and security. This role focuses on automation, modern infrastructure practices, and collaboration across engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions aligned with business outcomes. You will contribute to project teams and cross-department initiatives, working independently on defined tasks while receiving guidance on broader technical strategies. Your Main Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and document infrastructure and database automation components. Build and maintain cloud and platform solutions using automation, Infrastructure as a Service (Iaa S), and Platform as a Service (Paa S) technologies. Support containerized workloads using Kubernetes and Docker. Participate in incident investigation, troubleshooting, and on-call support using structured operational processes. Continuously improve platform capabilities by following technology trends and contributing enhancements to the engineering community. About the Ideal Candidate Qualifications and Skills University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant experience in platform engineering, infrastructure, or Dev Ops roles. Experience working with Linux systems (e.g., Red Hat distributions) and infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform and Ansible. Familiarity with scripting and automation using languages such as Python and shell scripting, as well as version control and continuous integration tools (Git, Jenkins). Experience with one or more cloud providers (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or Open Stack), container platforms, and exposure to artificial intelligence (AI) technologies at scale. title: QA Engineer 3 - ETL QA
jobDescription:
Job Title QA Engineer 3
- ETL QA Key Responsibilities Design, write, and execute test cases and SQL-based validations for ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion jobs. Perform source-to-target (S2T) reconciliation against the mapping specification — counts, values, and transformation rules. Validate data transformations: business rules, derivations, aggregations, joins, lookups, and cleansing logic. Test batch, incremental / change-data-capture (CDC), and streaming ingestion, including re-run and recovery behavior. Validate dimensional models — fact and dimension tables, surrogate/natural keys, referential integrity, and SCD handling. Build and maintain automated data-quality checks and regression suites; embed them as gates in CI/CD. Log, track, and triage defects; partner with data engineers to root-cause and retest. Perform performance and volume testing to confirm loads complete within SLA / batch windows. Contribute to data-quality frameworks, audit/control checks, lineage documentation, and reporting. Required Skills & Qualifications Strong SQL — complex joins, window functions, aggregations, set operations, and analytical queries for validation. Solid grasp of data warehousing and dimensional (Kimball) modeling — facts, dimensions, grain, and SCDs. Hands-on ETL/ELT testing experience with the org's stack [e.g., Informatica / Talend / SSIS / dbt / Azure Data Factory / AWS Glue]. Understanding of the data-quality dimensions: completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity, uniqueness, and timeliness. Experience testing both batch and incremental / CDC pipelines, including reject handling and idempotent re-runs. Scripting for test automation — Python (pandas) or equivalent. Familiarity with cloud data platforms [Snowflake / Big Query / Databricks / Synapse] and/or big-data (Spark, Hive). Version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and defect tracking (JIRA). BI/report validation exposure (Power BI / Tableau) is a plus. Should understand Linux systems Common accountabilities:
- Has the required technical/functional knowledge and experience in own discipline. Knowledge of the Amadeus business and how it is related to own area.
- Works using existing procedures or guidelines and provides inputs to support/influence area decisions. Makes recommendations on new solutions and proposes improvements by analyzing different sources of information.
- Works with a moderate level of guidance and direction from manager. Specific accountabilities: Test strategy * Attend to specification/architecture reviews (also on customer specification reviews when applicable), and provide feedback along with any potential impact, risk, issue or missed gap based on experience, * Define test strategy and test plan containing test cases (functional and non-functional), ensure traceability with specifications and customer requirements, * Ensure compliance of test strategy with CI/CD guidelines, Green IT guidelines and all quality guidelines (SDL, STDL), QA best practices/standards from the industry (ISTQB..), Test expertise * Design test cases and write test case scripts. * Prepare test environment, test data, and execute test cases. * Provide sign-off (go/no-go) on tested features based on defined exit criteria, * Continuously assess the need to add/update/remove test cases to existing regression and CI/CD pipeline when new product features are delivered and based on metrics (stabilization, deletion of flaky tests...), * As part of maintenance activities, investigate PTRs, test the fixes, and enrich test suites accordingly, Test automation * Assess necessity to automate subset of (or all) test
